About.p1: At Universo Merchan we believe a corporate gift can be much more than an object. It can be a way to thank, to welcome, to recognize, to inspire and to create a real bond between a brand and people.
About.p2: We created Universo Merchan with a very clear purpose: to help companies turn merchandising into a tool for emotional connection. In an increasingly digital world, we believe in the value of the tangible, in those details that are touched, used and remembered.
About.highlight: What sets us apart is the way we understand merchandising: not as a mere promotional medium, but as an opportunity to move, build loyalty and leave a mark.
About.p3: Our value proposition is to accompany brands in creating meaningful corporate gifts and personalized packs, aligned with their identity, their values and the moment they want to create for their clients, teams or partners. It's not just about choosing products, but about building memorable experiences through them.
About.p4: And above all, we're here to help you. Whether you need to find the right product, design a personalized pack or shape a special campaign for your brand, at Universo Merchan we want to accompany you throughout the process.

Reviews.title: What the brands that trust us say
Reviews.subtitle: The quality of our printing and our fast delivery back up our work in every advertising campaign.
Reviews.text_1: We ordered several personalized suitcases for a corporate event and the experience with this merchandising company was excellent from start to finish. From the very first contact, the team was very attentive. The quality of the suitcases exceeded our expectations.
Reviews.text_2: The experience with them has been excellent! The quality and fabric of their products (...) are very good, comfortable and durable. The design adapted to what we needed. Fast delivery times, good communication and very personalized service. We'll order again!
Reviews.text_3: A model of professionalism! Punctual, versatile and always improving. I'd also highlight their warm, personal approach.
